content: SELECT MEASURE(trip_count) AS trips FROM ${var.catalog}.${var.schema}.trip_metrics WHERE pickup_zip = 10001

content: SELECT pickup_hour, MEASURE(trip_count) AS trips FROM ${var.catalog}.${var.schema}.trip_metrics GROUP BY pickup_hour ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 1

content: SELECT pickup_hour, MEASURE(avg_fare) AS avg_fare FROM ${var.catalog}.${var.schema}.trip_metrics GROUP BY pickup_hour ORDER BY pickup_hour

content:
Use the trip_metrics metric view for counts, revenue, average fare and average distance. Query it with MEASURE(), for example MEASURE(trip_count).
Revenue means the sum of fare_amount in USD. Tips and tolls are not in this data.
Use the trips table only for row-level questions, such as the longest single trip.
When a question says 'busiest', rank by trip_count.
